name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: A translator that lets an AI agent operate any command-line program as if it had a proper point-and-click interface, so the AI can drive existing software instead of being limited to a few supported tools.
buyer: A developer building AI-agent products who needs their agent to control specialized software (video tools, data tools, internal CLIs) that has no official AI integration.
business_use_cases: An AI automation agency wires a client's legacy in-house CLI tools into an agent workflow in a day instead of writing custom integrations for each one.
A no-code automation startup uses it to let customers' AI agents control any installed desktop software without the startup building a connector per app.
An IT consultancy sells 'make your internal tools AI-agent-ready' as a packaged service built on top of it.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid custom-integration services that wire specific CLIs into client AI-agent stacks.
Build a hosted marketplace of pre-made CLI-to-agent adapters and charge per adapter or per seat.

steal_this: Pick one popular but AI-unfriendly CLI tool (ffmpeg, imagemagick, a niche data tool), wrap it with this, and ship a tiny hosted API that lets anyone's AI agent use it — charge per call.
